description.name: Extra Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses.

description.name: Extra Mode: Kain (Lightning)

description.name: Instant ATB 1

description.name: Attach Lightning 3 with Secondary Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 5, up to Attach Lightning 5
